summary: Iteration 11 verified the standalone ERP Billing workspace refactor (Phase 1) end-to-end. Backend regression: 7/7 endpoints (/api/billing/invoices, /api/billing/products, /api/billing/customers, /api/billing/suppliers, /api/ledgers, /api/udhaar, /api/analytics/summary) return 200 for a freshly registered user. Frontend: registered a fresh user, /billing renders BillingLayout with data-testid=billing-sidebar + billing-header (no main Layout hamburger/nav). All 8 sidebar sections present with correct data-testids (billing-nav-{sales,purchase,parties,inventory,payments,ledgers,reports,settings}); Sales is auto-expanded and 'Sales Returns' child link exists; Purchase toggles open on click and reveals children. Header Create dropdown -> Sale Invoice navigates to /billing/invoices/new?type=tax and sidebar stays visible. All 4 new pages render (sales-returns-page, customer-ledger-page + search + 'Koi customer nahi mila' empty state, supplier-ledger-page + 'Koi supplier nahi mila', inventory-adjustments-page with all 4 KPIs Total Products/Stock Value/Low Stock/Out of Stock). Existing billing routes (/billing/invoices, /quotations, /parties, /inventory, /outstanding, /ledgers, /reports, /settings) all render inside the ERP shell. billing-back-to-personal button lands on /dashboard with main Layout; no billing-sidebar leak on /dashboard, /transactions, /accounts, /budgets.

minor.issue: Endpoint does not exist (returns 404). CustomerLedger.jsx and SupplierLedger.jsx call http.get('/parties') which silently fails via .catch(()=>[]) leaving both ledgers empty forever even when the user has customers/suppliers. The correct endpoints are /api/billing/customers and /api/billing/suppliers.

integration_issues.issue: Uses http.get('/parties') which 404s. Ledger will always show 'Koi customer nahi mila' empty state even for users with customers. Should call /billing/customers (or /billing/customers + /billing/suppliers merged, filtered by party_type).
Uses http.get('/parties') which 404s. Ledger will always show 'Koi supplier nahi mila' empty state even for users with suppliers. Should call /billing/suppliers.

action_items: Fix CustomerLedger.jsx and SupplierLedger.jsx: replace http.get('/parties') with http.get('/billing/customers') and http.get('/billing/suppliers') respectively (or combine both and filter by party_type). The current .catch(()=>[]) masks a real 404 so ledgers appear empty for real users.
critical_code_review_comments: CustomerLedger.jsx L26 and SupplierLedger.jsx L26 call a non-existent /api/parties endpoint but swallow the error via .catch(()=>[]); this makes the empty-state test pass on a fresh account but silently breaks the feature for any real user with parties. Prefer explicit error surfacing (toast on failure) and hit the real endpoints /billing/customers and /billing/suppliers.
BillingSidebar.jsx has typo `currentPas` / `pas` (should be `pathAndSearch` or similar) — cosmetic but hurts readability.

BillingSidebar.jsx initialExpanded is memoized on `pas` but useState only reads the initial value; expanded state won't auto-open a section on client-side navigation between two collapsed groups (works for direct load only). Consider a useEffect that merges new auto-expand keys into `expanded` when pas changes.
BillingLayout.jsx keeps `financialYear` in local state but never propagates it downstream (no context/URL sync) — the FY switcher is UI-only right now, downstream pages don't filter by it.

BillingHeader Create menu 'Credit Note / Sales Return' navigates to /billing/invoices/new?type=credit while SalesReturns 'New Sales Return' also uses ?type=credit — consistent, but Invoices.jsx uses type='credit-note' string, so ensure InvoiceCreate normalizes both.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of refactor acceptance criteria met; 2 latent integration bugs in ledger data loads (masked by .catch)

seed_data_creation: None persistent; backend user cleaned up via DELETE /api/auth/me.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor is functionally correct. The only real bug found is CustomerLedger/SupplierLedger calling /parties (404). Backend never had /api/parties — always used /api/billing/customers and /api/billing/suppliers. After fix, retest by seeding a customer via POST /api/billing/customers and confirming it shows in Customer Ledger table.
rca of the issue: CustomerLedger.jsx/SupplierLedger.jsx were written against an assumed unified /parties collection endpoint that doesn't exist server-side. Server exposes GET /api/billing/customers and GET /api/billing/suppliers only (grep of server.py confirms no /api/parties route). The Promise.all wrapper uses .catch(()=>[]) which converts the 404 into an empty array, so the UI shows the 'Koi customer/supplier nahi mila' empty state instead of surfacing the error.
